@graph.name: How an Acrylic Pros aquarium is designed, fabricated and installed
@graph.description: At Acrylic Pros, we design and fabricate aquariums with precision, elegance, and durability, creating a breathtaking centerpiece that will last a lifetime.

step.name: Design Drawings
step.text: Our design team provides a full set of production drawings prior to fabrication to ensure a seamless collaboration.

step.name: Quality Materials
step.text: We use only the highest grade acrylic and glass, to provide our customers with top quality products that will last a lifetime.

step.name: Craftsmanship
step.text: Step by step, your aquarium will come to life with our team of experts that will pay attention to every detail to ensure your new aquarium is flawless.

step.name: Installation
step.text: There are many moving parts and components that make an aquarium come to life. Installation process reveals a level of quality and complexity that is very unique to the aquarium industry.
